name: centre-cfs
description: Site trilingue du Centre CFS : générateur Python, Worker Cloudflare, moteur Google Sheets, comptes Supabase.

scripts.dev: SITE_URL=http://localhost:8787 BASE_PATH= WORKER_API=1 CHATBOT_ENABLED=1 CHATBOT_PROVIDER=workers-ai python3 site/build.py --dev && wrangler dev --port 8787
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:py && npm run check
scripts.check: python3 site/tools/check_i18n.py && python3 site/tools/check_links.py && python3 site/tools/check_seo.py
scripts.build:worker: SITE_URL=https://centrecfs.be BASE_PATH= WORKER_API=1 CHATBOT_ENABLED=1 CHATBOT_PROVIDER=workers-ai python3 site/build.py
